remarks: Welcome to Cove View - East Norwalk: Lovely townhouse style condo/apt offers 2 BRs/2 full Baths in East Norwalk water community. Walk to the water- quiet dead-end street. Open floorplan w/plenty of natural light. Living Room w/sliders to private deck to relax and enjoy partial water views.  Kitchen w/breakfast bar, granite countertops, stainless appliances. Bedroom w/vaulted ceiling, skylights & walk-in closet, a full Bath completes 1st level. 2nd floor you'll find updated full Bath and Primary BR w/skylight & vaulted ceiling. Off street 2 parking spaces, professionally landscaped yard complete this rental. New flooring in both BR's. New carpeting on both stairways being installed 10/28. Very walkable neighborhood - East & South Norwalk train stations, minutes to beaches, farm to table market, liquor store, restaurants, ice cream shop, Copps Island Oysters, SoNo Collection Mall, shops & restaurants, Maritime Museum & Aquarium, Shorehaven Golf course, Shore & Country Club. Commuters delight by Metro north train, I-95 & Merritt Pwy. - Only 55 miles north of NYC. Good credit & references a must. 2 Months Security. Efficient gas heat, ductless AC units. Come and enjoy the lifestyle of the 06855 water community.
